Process lesson: a research subagent asserted the Special Preferred Enterprise ILS 1bn / same-sector condition was wrong. Reading section 51כ and section 51כד directly showed the SKILL.md text was right and the reviewer had imported the figure from the wrong provision. Verify before correcting, in both directions.

Process lesson: the Judge correctly caught the four-employee exclusion but cited it to section 62א(א)(4); the Ordinance shows (4) is deleted and the exclusion is (5). Reviewer findings are leads, not text to transcribe.

Expert MAJOR (raised in priority, still deferred): the script's headline 'Indicative enterprise value RANGE' sits directly under a materially smaller equity-after-discounts figure and there is no equity range anywhere. Run the bridge and both discounts INSIDE sensitivity_grid() and add the DLOM axis Step 10 already requires. Closest of the deferred items to producing a wrong quoted number.

Expert MAJOR (deferred, must not survive another cycle): the section 14 severance arrangement is not distinguished, so Step 7 and equity_bridge() treat the shortfall as unconditional. Under a full הסדר סעיף 14 there is no company-level shortfall to deduct at all, and most post-2008 Israeli employment sits there.

Process lesson: the C4 script fix was applied to the staleness flag and the vintage line but NOT to the arithmetic the same code comment named, so for one round the separate-country-premium convention INVERTED the sign of country risk (a riskier Israel produced a lower cost of equity and a higher valuation). Fixed in this cycle by holding the mature-market ERP as its own constant instead of deriving it by subtraction. Writing a comment that names a defect is not fixing it.
